name: anycar-circuit-lap-v2-monaco-6
goal: Track one complete lap of a scaled circuit at the prescribed speed; cross every ordered gate and finish line, avoiding collisions/offtrack. Record actual finish-crossing time.
score: Ordered completion and time-indexed position/heading/speed accuracy. Safety violation gives zero. No nearest-waypoint score.
evaluation_backend: native MuJoCo CPU + OSMesa + NumPy CPU
limitations: Procedural chassis with retained contact-wheel mechanism. Rigid Coulomb friction is not deformable sand. No AnyCar learned transformer is evaluated. Planar SVG-derived schematic, smoothed and uniformly scaled for RC steering; no elevation/bridge reconstruction.
geometry: Planar SVG-derived schematic, smoothed and uniformly scaled for RC steering; no elevation/bridge reconstruction.

runtime_budget.wall_time_estimate_basis: CPU OSMesa planning estimate: 2 wall seconds per simulated second plus 60 seconds; validate on deployment hardware

completion: All ordered gates, spaced at most 0.5 m, including the finish line
visual_feedback: Continuous public commanded centerline in both video panels; no moving target dot or privileged overlay.
image_sampling: Up to 128 equally spread video frame indices, including first and last; full 10 Hz telemetry.
